slides.texte_overlay:
5 signs a man is quietly
confident
1. He asks for help without shame. "Can you show me how this works?" Only insecure men pretend to know everything.
2. He's comfortable with silence. He doesn't rush to fill every pause. A relaxed silence shows he's at ease with himself.
3. He dresses for himself. Simple clothes that fit, chosen because he likes them, not to impress anyone. Comfort first.
4. He takes feedback well. "Good point, I'll fix it." No defensiveness, no excuses. Confidence makes criticism easy to hear.
5. He keeps learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and knowing a bit about everything makes me relaxed anywhere.
slides.texte_sophia: 5. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Knowing a bit about everything makes me relaxed anywhere.

slides.texte_overlay: Bonus: he admits when he's wrong. Quickly and simply. It takes far more confidence than defending a mistake. Say it out loud.
Quiet confidence doesn't need an audience. It shows in small, ordinary moments, every single day. Watch for them.
